name: Precious Melody & Your Familiar Tale
source: A story where you play through your own version of the tale. Meeting all kinds of girls that would later become your companion. In a forest where your humble beginning will lead you into a long journey of hardship as well as learning the good things in it.
translation: 一个你可以玩自己版本的故事的故事。遇见各种各样的女孩，她们后来会成为你的伴侣。在一片森林里，你卑微的开始将带领你踏上一段漫长的艰辛之旅，同时也将在其中学习美好的事物。
